import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    down, up = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] != bg:
                down[r-c].append((r,c,g[r][c]))
                up[r+c].append((r,c,g[r][c]))
    ds = {k:v for k,v in down.items() if len(v)>=2}
    us = {k:v for k,v in up.items() if len(v)>=2}
    # Continue diagonal strokes only when the picture contains strokes in both diagonal orientations.
    if ds and us:
        for groups, orient in ((ds, 1), (us, -1)):
            for k, pts in groups.items():
                pts = sorted(pts)
                if orient == 1:  # r-c = k
                    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r-c == k]
                else:  # r+c = k
                    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r+c == k]
                for r,c in cells:
                    if g[r][c] != bg:
                        continue
                    nearest = min(pts, key=lambda p: abs(p[0]-r))
                    g[r][c] = nearest[2]
    return g
'''
